ORDER Heard on admission.
2. It is submitted by learned counsel for the respondent that the presence of respondent No.2 is not required as liability for payment of compensation is on the Insurance Company.
3. It is also submitted that the original record would not be required.
The appeal is admitted for hearing.

4. With the consent of learned counsel for the parties, appeal is finally heard and disposed of as below.
5.

This appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed by appellant/claimant against the impugned award dated 11.12.2018 passed by 1st AMACT, Jatara,
District Tikamgarh in Claim NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:6520 2 MA-1636-2019 case No.36/2017 [Maqbool Baig Vs. Sahida Khan and others] seeking enhancement of compensation of Rs.50,000/- by paying a court fee of Rs.1250/-.

entities.text: Maqbool Baig Vs. Sahida Khan and others]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The learned Tribunal has awarded Makbul Beg vs Sahid Khan on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/97912554/
1 total compensation of Rs.8,024/- to the claimant for injuries sustained by him in an accident dated 27.09.2015.
6.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the respondent that learned Tribunal has awarded compensation on lower side for sustaining simple injury.
It is informed that the appellant sustained injuries in the rib cage.
7. Learned counsel for the Insurance Company supports the award.

8. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
Taking into consideration, this Court is of the considered view that less amount of compensation has been awarded.
9.
As stated above, it is prima facie established that learned Tribunal failed to fix compensation with sensibility required.
Let it be remembered that strict rule of evidence is not required in motor accident claim cases.
Therefore, the interest of justice would be best served if on lump sum basis Rs.10,000/- is enhanced on pain and suffering.
Thus, Rs.10,000/- is enhanced under the aforesaid head.
10. With the aforesaid enhancement in the amount of compensation by Rs.10,000/- only the instant appeal is partly allowed.
11. Rate of interest and other terms and conditions shall remain the same as held by learned Claims Tribunal.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:6520 3 MA-1636-2019 12.
Accordingly, the appeal stands disposed of.

(AVANINDRA KUMAR SINGH) JUDGE NRJ Makbul Beg vs Sahid Khan on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/97912554/
